observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached. The word 'Nikon' is visible on the top of the camera body. The lens has 'NIKKOR AF-S DX 18-55G' engraved on it. The camera is placed on a white crumpled paper with 'McSteve' branding.

Photo 1: Side view of the camera, showing the lens with focus and zoom rings, and the camera's side buttons. The model 'D3300' is visible on the top right of the camera body. A black and yellow strap is attached to the camera.
Photo 2: Side view from the rear, showing the camera's rear panel with a hot shoe and buttons. The lens is attached, and the strap is visible. The background shows shelves with boxed electronics.
All photos have a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI MCSTEVE'.

read_from: photo 1 top right of camera body

claims.claim: This is a Used Nikon D3300 DSLR camera with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'Nikon' and 'D3300' on the camera body. Photo 0 and photo 1 show 'NIKKOR AF-S DX 18-55G' on the lens.
No photo shows the camera powered on, taking a photo, or any functional test. The claim cannot be verified from the images alone.
The lens glass is visible in all photos, but there is no clear view of the front or rear glass to confirm condition. The seller's text is incomplete.

risks.risk: Camera may not be functional (e.g., shutter, sensor, or electronics may be faulty)
risks.proof: A video clip showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying a clear image on the screen.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or scratches not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements, especially under bright light, to check for scratches or haze.

risks.risk: Camera may have internal dust, fungus, or moisture damage
risks.proof: Photo of the camera's sensor and body interior, or a video showing the camera being opened and closed to check for dust or corrosion.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements.
Photo of the camera's sensor and body interior.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
